# plugin.txt syntax the matchers have to survive: comments, quoting and
# PLUGIN_TEXT / VARIABLE_TEXT blocks whose lines look like keywords. Values used
# as discovery parameters are split on spaces, as the plugin dialog does.
PLUGIN_TEXT_START
  # Not a comment, a markdown heading
  VARIABLE_DISCOVERY openc3/discovery/serial_discovery.py 0000:0000
PLUGIN_TEXT_END
VARIABLE model 'basic' # Single quotes and a trailing comment
  VARIABLE_DESCRIPTION 'Which model, e.g. "basic"'
  VARIABLE_STATE "Basic model" basic
    VARIABLE_TEXT_START
    VARIABLE_STATE_SET mdns_types _fake._tcp.local.
    VARIABLE_TEXT_END
    VARIABLE_STATE_SET mdns_types "_basic._tcp.local.|name=Basic Unit*"
  VARIABLE_STATE 'Pro model' pro
    VARIABLE_STATE_SET mdns_types '_pro._tcp.local.'
VARIABLE mdns_types ""
  VARIABLE_HIDDEN
VARIABLE host ""
  VARIABLE_DISCOVERY openc3/discovery/zeroconf_discovery.py ${mdns_types}
